Class CoreCapabilityProvider

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.capability.core.CoreCapabilityProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:

public final class CoreCapabilityProvider extends Object implements CapabilityProvider
Core capability contributor: prints what core assumes/uses and what it can infer from the environment.

    • source

      public String source()
      Description copied from interface: CapabilityProvider
      A stable, user-friendly source id for this provider.

      The default implementation derives a name from the class name by removing "CapabilityProvider" suffix and converting to lowercase.

      Specified by:
      source in interface CapabilityProvider

      source id (e.g. "tamboui-core", "tamboui-image")

    • contribute

      public void contribute(CapabilityReportBuilder report)
      Description copied from interface: CapabilityProvider
      Contribute information to the capability report.

      Providers SHOULD use dotted keys for CapabilityReportBuilder.feature(String, String, Object) to create stable namespaces (e.g. image.protocol.kitty). Providers SHOULD NOT fail when contributing to the report; if something goes wrong, they should report that as a missing feature/info.

      Specified by:
      contribute in interface CapabilityProvider
      Parameters:
      report - report builder
